items.source: @Configuration class that registers an AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect capable of performing dependency injection services for non-Spring managed objects annotated with @Configurable.
items.translation: 注册了 `AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect` 的 `@Configuration` 类，该切面能够对带有 @Configurable 注解的非 Spring 托管对象执行依赖注入服务。

items.source: Signals the current application context to apply dependency injection to non-managed classes that are instantiated outside the Spring bean factory (typically classes annotated with the @Configurable annotation).
items.translation: 向当前应用程序上下文发出信号，以便对由 Spring bean 工厂外部实例化的非托管类（通常是带有@Configurable注解的类）应用依赖注入。

items.source: AspectJ-based dependency injection support driven by the @Configurable annotation.
items.translation: 由 `@Configurable` 注解驱动的基于 AspectJ 的依赖注入支持。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。
